notes: README only covers installing a release zip (no commands) and a separate Docker section (`docker pull linkstackorg/linkstack`); the from-source dev steps are in CONTRIBUTING.md. The repo commits a ready .env (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, empty APP_KEY), an empty database/database.sqlite and an INSTALLING marker (which routes to the web setup wizard), so no env-copy step and no DB service; .env.example (MySQL) is a stale Laravel default and copying it would break the SQLite setup. APP_KEY generation is not documented for source checkouts; the release workflow touches storage/app/ISINSTALLED so routes/web.php generates the key there. CONTRIBUTING uses `composer update -vvv` (re-resolves); composer.lock as committed needs PHP >=8.2 (Symfony 7.4 packages) while composer.json says >=8.0 and release CI uses PHP 8.0 with composer update. Seeded admin: admin@admin.com / 12345678. Docs say to serve via a local web server (Apache etc.; index.php is at the repo root and bootstrap/app.php binds public path to the root); `php artisan serve` is inferred, not documented. package.json/laravel-mix exist but no view uses mix() and assets are committed under assets/, so no npm step.
